main.name: Athlete data
main.description: An athlete's permissioned data: one space per visibility tier (followers, mutuals, self), plus an interactions space holding the athlete's likes and comments on non-public activities, their hides of comments on their own non-public activities, and their blocks and mutes. The AppView is the managing app and decides who may read each space; it also syncs them. From a tier it indexes only feed.activity, feed.activityDetails, feed.activityStreams and feed.activityZones records and serves them only to the viewers the tier admits. The self tier also holds each activity's full-resolution feed.activityTrack and each imported activity's original file (feed.activitySource) and devices (feed.activityDevices), which only the athlete reads, their actor.privacyZones and actor.routeTrim, and their feed.segmentStar stars on segments: the AppView ignores all six. Each tier also holds the athlete's gear.item records of that visibility (their Public gear is in their repo), which the AppView doesn't index yet. While the athlete has segment matching on (actor.segmentPrefs, in self), self also holds a feed.segmentTrack per activity with a track, trimmed by their privacy zones: the AppView indexes those two from self only, uses segment tracks only while matching is on, and never serves either. While the athlete has chosen age, weight and gender leaderboards, self also holds their actor.leaderboardBrackets (brackets only, never the details), which the AppView indexes from self only, uses only to filter leaderboards and never serves. Only the athlete and the AppView read the interactions space; the AppView indexes only feed.like, feed.comment, feed.commentHide, graph.block and graph.mute records from it. It shows each like only to viewers who, like its giver, may see the liked activity now, and each comment only to those who also belong to the audience it was written for, unless the athlete hid it.
